order_layer.note: Order-layer precision was not a registered aggregate gate, but non-stationary order windows make the passing order bound provisional until revalidation.

interpretation: Most timestep failures came from the reversal-shape detector, often while absolute drift was below its metric tolerance. Requiring every metric in every stochastic replicate to pass this unadjusted shape check creates a likely multiple-testing problem. Window-length sensitivity must be diagnosed before choosing an independent V1B design.
